title: Refill Log
content: The Refill Log page gives you a complete view of every LN2 top-up across all containers — tank status, reservoir inventory, and a full activity history.

title: Open Refill Log
content: Click here to open the Refill Log page.

title: Refill Detected
content: The system automatically detects when a container has been refilled based on sensor data. Each card here represents a pending detection waiting for your review — confirm or dismiss it to keep the log accurate.

title: Detection Card
content: This card shows a refill detected for container T-161 in Bangalore on 21/04/26 at 08:15 AM — 5.2 kg of LN2 added. Click Add Log to convert this detection into a confirmed refill record.

title: Add Log
content: Click here to open the Add Log form for this detection.

title: Add Log Form
content: The form is pre-filled from the detection — tank T-161, Bangalore reservoir, date and time, and 5.2 kg refill weight. Set who performed the refill and add any notes before saving.

title: Save the Log
content: Click Save to confirm the refill and add it to the activity log.

title: Active Tank Status
content: Every active container and its current LN2 level is listed here. Tanks approaching the minimum threshold are flagged so refills can be scheduled before a critical alert fires.

title: Reservoir Logs
content: Track bulk LN2 orders and deliveries for each branch reservoir. Ordered and received dates are logged here to keep your supply chain transparent and auditable.

title: Recent Activity Log
content: Every refill event — who performed it, when, how much LN2 was added, and any notes — is recorded here. This is your complete audit trail for compliance and maintenance reviews.
